'''Chowder''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

One Chowder may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Chowder is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Chowder is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Fringed Vest]].  [[File:Shirt283a.png|24px]]

==Quests==
Chowder is not used in any [[quests]].

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|The Chowder recipe accepts [[Large Milk]] in addition to [[Milk|regular milk]].}}
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
